photos.scope: Exact nearest-rank over every valid observed terminal record, including rejected/error. No latency for missing terminal logs is invented.

tracking.method: Subtract first snapshot from last within each inferred counter segment. Sum deltas only; never sum cumulative snapshots.
limitations: First prefixes and unreported tails are omitted. Unobservable resets may undercount activity.
Resets are inferred from counter/bucket decreases; elapsedMs alone is not a counter reset.
Rate uses device epoch envelopes, not the restartable reporting clock or camera sensor frames.
Histogram percentile bounds describe retained delta events only, not exact or whole-session latency.

memory.scope: Sampled process PSS; first/last change alone cannot establish or exclude a memory leak.

surface.scope: Observed surface composition frames per collector elapsed second; finite history may omit frames. Not sensor FPS or camera throughput.

entry.roi_annotation_origin: Existing nativeSelfTest ROI, not a label for the whole 450x257 image

declared_feed.binding: Operator-declared feed; verify actual camera orientation/placement visually.

actions.scope: Recorded actions/observations only. A Pindai tap does not prove capture, decoding success or a matching photo metric.

limitations: Offline input/APK identity binding does not prove that this APK or current source was installed/running; pair with build/install evidence.
Collection completeness and observed emulator results are separate from model accuracy, physical-camera readiness and release acceptance.
Counters contain no session identity; segment resets are inferred. Missing logs and action-to-photo correspondence remain unproven.
